checks.name: Spatial Group Disjointness
checks.description: Verifies training and validation folds share zero Enumeration Areas (EAs)
checks.details: Zero overlapping EAs across all 5 spatial cross-validation folds.

checks.name: Target Variable Isolation
checks.description: Verifies target Y_vol is strictly excluded from feature space and no trivial target proxies exist
checks.details: Target variable completely isolated. Maximum absolute feature correlation: 0.4365.

checks.name: Scaler & Imputation Isolation
checks.description: Verifies preprocessing scalers and medians are strictly computed on training folds
checks.details: Preprocessing scalers and imputers conform strictly to out-of-fold fit boundaries.

checks.name: Unsupervised Representation Isolation (KMeans & PCA)
checks.description: Verifies KMeans cluster centroids and PCA latent components are computed strictly on training data
checks.details: Latent representations (KMeans agronomic clusters and PCA components) strictly isolated.

checks.name: Feature Selection & Lookahead Integrity
checks.description: Verifies feature selection ranking does not access validation target values or lookahead timestamps
checks.details: Top-100 features selected using independent tree-gain importance; validation targets zero-masked.
